messages.content: list style se kya hota hai in simple words

**List style** CSS property ka use web pages me lists (unordered ya ordered) ki appearance control karne ke liye hota hai. Yeh property mainly teen cheezon ko define karti hai:  

1. **list-style-type** → Bullet ya number ka style set karta hai (jaise disc, circle, square, decimal, roman numbers, etc.).  
2. **list-style-position** → Bullet/number ka position set karta hai (inside ya outside).  
3. **list-style-image** → Custom image ko bullet points ki jagah use karne ke liye hota hai.  

Agar in teeno properties ko ek saath ek shorthand property me likhna ho, toh **list-style** property use hoti hai.  

### Example:
```css
ul {
  list-style: square inside; 
}
```
Iska matlab hai ki list ke bullets **square shape** ke honge aur **list item ke andar** dikhai denge.  

Samajh aaya? 😃

    `)** ya **ordered list (`
      `)** banate ho, toh usme by default **bullets (•) ya numbers (1, 2, 3, etc.)** aate hain. Agar aap **`list-style: none;`** likh doge, toh yeh bullets ya numbers **gayab ho jayenge**! 🎩✨ ### 🔹 Example (Without `list-style: none;`) ```html

      • Banana
      • Cherry
      ``` 🔹 Output: - Apple - Banana - Cherry ### 🔹 Example (With `list-style: none;`) ```html
      • Apple
      • Banana
      • Cherry
      ``` 🔹 Output: Apple Banana Cherry 🎯 **Result:** Bullets **gayab ho gaye!** 👉 Yeh **mostly navigation menus** ya **custom-styled lists** me use hota hai jaha aap apni marzi se icons ya styling add karna chahte ho. Ab samajh aaya? 😃
